name: M-NCPPC Youth Advisory Council (YAC)
org: M-NCPPC Department of Parks and Recreation, Prince George's County
what_you_do: You join about 20 high school youth. You advise the parks department. You plan teen events and community service projects. You join leadership conferences and field trips.
who_can_apply: About 20 high school-age youth who live in Prince George's County. No other rule is stated on the page.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Members earn student service learning credits or community service hours.
duration: School year; meetings in person at community centers and online
how_to_apply: Email your name, resume, school information and a list of extracurricular activities to the contact named on the page (301-446-3416 for questions).
notes: The same page lists other teen programs (Teen Arts Council, Teen Vocal Showcase for ages 10 to 18, Teen Nights for ages 10 to 17). Unpaid, so no work permit.
